units.source_text: 六条妃子如此妒恨忧恼，身心亦异常困顿。

en.t: Lady Rokujo was so consumed by jealousy and sorrow that both body and spirit were unusually exhausted.

units.source_text: 她想请僧人做法事，以祈祷健康。

en.t: She wished to invite monks to perform religious rites and pray for her recovery.

units.source_text: 但因女儿斋宫尚未离去，未便在邸内举行，便暂时迁居他处，诵经礼忏。

en.t: But because her daughter, the Saiin, had not yet departed, it was inconvenient to hold the rites in the residence, so she temporarily moved elsewhere to have sutras chanted and penitential prayers offered.

units.source_text: 源氏大将闻此消息，深为挂念，不知妃子健康如何，便下决心，前去访问。

en.t: When General Genji heard this news, he became deeply concerned, and not knowing how the lady's health was, he resolved to go and visit her.

units.source_text: 此时妃子借居他处，源氏大将只得微行而往。

en.t: At that time the lady was staying temporarily elsewhere, so General Genji had no choice but to go there quietly and in private.

units.source_text: 他首先说明：近来久疏问候，实乃意外之事，怠慢之罪，务请原宥。

en.t: First he explained that his long neglect in asking after her lately had been truly unintended, and begged her to forgive the fault of his negligence.

units.source_text: 然后诉说葵姬病状，言道：“我并不何等操心。

en.t: Then he spoke of Lady Aoi's condition, saying, "I myself am not especially worried.

units.source_text: 但她的父母看得很重，非常着急，痛苦不堪。

en.t: But her parents take it very seriously, are extremely anxious, and are suffering unbearably.

units.source_text: 我未便坐视，在她病重期间，只得从旁照料。

en.t: I cannot simply stand by and watch, so while her illness is grave I have no choice but to attend to her at her side.

units.source_text: 你倘能宽宏大量，原谅万事，我就不胜欣喜了。”

en.t: If you can be generous of heart and forgive everything, I shall be more grateful than I can say."

units.source_text: 他看见妃子神色比往常憔悴，觉得此实难怪之事，深感同情。

en.t: Seeing that the lady looked more haggard than usual, he felt that this was only natural and was filled with deep sympathy.
